routed_overlap.mechanism: MoT (Mixture-of-Transformers): a boolean per-token routing mask (`image_gen_indicators`) selects between two disjoint, duplicate weight sets (understanding-path modules vs. `_mot_gen`-suffixed generation-path modules) inside the Qwen3 language-model backbone. This is a hard boolean split of duplicate weights, not a learned MoE gate over expert sub-networks (the out-of-scope A3B variant uses the latter; the two mechanisms are not interchangeable and are not conflated in this audit).

static_assumption_violation.location: src/sensenova_u1/models/neo_unify/modeling_qwen3.py, decoder-layer and attention forward() methods (e.g. lines ~751-772, ~1003-1004 at pinned commit f97964a6e54b0abf92aa2db849af4e942bb2ff08)
static_assumption_violation.description: The released code's forward() branches only cover the two pure cases (all-understanding tokens, or all-generation tokens, i.e. exist_non_image_gen_tokens XOR exist_image_gen_tokens). The mixed case (a single forward pass containing both understanding and generation tokens simultaneously) hits an explicit `raise NotImplementedError("The mixed und/gen forward path is not yet validated (issue #207): known issues are fixed, but it has no parity test and no production caller. Split the sequence at token-type boundaries and use forward_und / forward_gen.")`. This is a static, code-visible assumption violation of "the router can route arbitrary token mixes": the released code assumes callers pre-split by token type, and explicitly refuses (rather than silently mis-computing) the mixed case.
static_assumption_violation.trigger_condition: exist_non_image_gen_tokens is True AND exist_image_gen_tokens is True within the same forward() call
static_assumption_violation.note: Both admission smokes (VQA-only understanding, T2I-only generation) each hit exactly one pure branch and completed with exit_code 0; neither smoke triggers the NotImplementedError. This is recorded as a documented upstream code-path limitation of the released repository, not a failure of this admission's required smokes.

block_disjointness_check.method: Directly enumerated model.named_parameters() (deduplicated by Python object id) and classified every name against the upstream repository's own DEFAULT_GROUPS rules in src/sensenova_u1/utils/param_count.py; independently reran the classification programmatically to confirm no parameter falls into an unmatched catch-all group. See configs/admission/sensenova-u1/parameter-block-registry.yaml for the full per-block breakdown.
